name: net_lod_gusts
description: VUH-2342: 08/08 programs 0/1/0 (three F_MU070 wind gusts). The host, then the friend, walks up the path into the wind for 20 s while filmed; each walk's position samples count pushbacks (the player moved back more than 15 units between samples while walking forward). The friend's gusts run natively on the friend now, so the wind must push the friend too.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))

steps.name: 1 Wind gusts F_MU070 act on both players

steps.expr: [[(round(a['position']['x']),round(a['position']['z'])) for a in actors(i) if a['name']=='F_MU070'] for i in range(2)]
[[(round(a['position']['x']),round(a['position']['z'])) for a in actors(i) if a['name']=='F_MU070'] for i in range(2)]
[sum(1 for k in range(1,len(saved[w]['samples'])) if saved[w]['samples'][k]['position'][2] < saved[w]['samples'][k-1]['position'][2]-15) for w in ('walk_host','walk_friend')]

steps.message: no gust pushed the friend back while it walked into the wind
